requirements.testing: Full test suite (unit, repository, widget, integration)
requirements.sequence: Sequential: Isar → Horse merge → Error handling → Phone auth
constraints: Domain layer must remain pure Dart (no Isar/Flutter imports)

Phone + email registration with no OTP/email confirmation
